audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text is generic ('EVEN', 5.5/10) and the lane framing never names why the lane is even: Brand out-ranges and out-clears Ahri early (Q 1050, W 900) but has zero mobility, so every stage after 6 is Ahri's.
audit.why: Brand's stun (Sear) is conditional on the target being ablaze — that single condition is the whole early lane, and the difficulty text never says it.
audit.corrected: Even to level 5 because his W/E outrange and outclear you; yours from 6 because he has no dash and Spirit Rush makes charm angles he cannot answer.
sources: brief.enemyKit (Sear text: 'If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun'), brief.ownerKit

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagrees with itself: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while win[4..6] read 'Ahri' and the packet levelChart reads Ahri for those three rows.
audit.why: Two layers render two different answers to 'who wins Level 6'. Packet chart and content layer agree on Ahri; the full layer is the outlier.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side, phases[5].side, phases[6].side all become 'Ahri' to match win[4..6] and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability-name/mechanic errors in the content layer: spikes[0].text calls the passive 'Conflagration' (the passive is Blaze; Conflagration is E) and is ungrammatical ('you have Fox-Fire flat-out beats'); wants.you[2] says 'before he can stack Conflagration' — Conflagration does not stack, Blaze does (3 stacks, then detonates in 2 seconds).
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Brand's spells light his targets ablaze... stacking up to 3 times... When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion... It detonates in 2 seconds.' Sear only stuns an ablaze target, so the decisive interaction is refusing the first Blaze application, not dodging Q.
audit.corrected: Name Blaze as the passive; state that Sear's stun requires Blaze already on you, so the dodge that matters is W (Pillar of Flame, short delay) and E (Conflagration, 625 range), not the stun itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims 'Brand can deny your mobility (Spirit Rush) with Pillar of Flame' on the strength of a derived 'terrain' flag on his W.
audit.why: Riot's own W description contains no terrain creation — it is a delayed damage zone. The derived flag contradicts the description, so per the calibration rule the description wins. Asserting that Pillar of Flame blocks Spirit Rush would be a fabricated interaction.
audit.corrected: Not written. Pillar of Flame is treated as a delayed ground AoE that applies Blaze, nothing more.
sources: brief.enemyKit W text vs brief.enemyKit W flags

audit.why: Real numbers now used: Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Conflagration 13/12/11/10/9, Pyroclasm 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Bank the third Spirit Rush dash for the exit once Pyroclasm (100s at rank 1) and Sear are spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave is champion-generic Ahri text with no Brand content.
audit.why: Brand clears a wave with W+E faster than Ahri's orb, so 'shove first' is a real instruction in this specific lane rather than a default.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around his clear speed and W zoning the back casters.
sources: brief.enemyKit W/E (AoE, 900/625 range, spread doubled when ablaze)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Ahri's Charm (E) 'instantly stops movement abilities' and that Brand has none — he is one of the few mid laners with no dash, blink or mobility spell at all.
audit.why: That asymmetry is why every post-6 row belongs to Ahri and why a landed charm on Brand is close to a guaranteed kill.
sources: brief.enemyKit (no dash/blink flags on any Brand ability)

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by lighting you with Pillar of Flame, then stunning the ablaze target with Sear as Blaze detonates.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry through picks — charm Brand before Pyroclasm leaves his hands and his fight ends; dashes keep you outside his 625 E.

edits.before: If Brand gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Sear (Stun) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through charm picks.
edits.after: If Brand gets a kill, never eat W or E first — unlit, his Sear cannot stun you. Two kills: farm with Q clears, buy Null-Magic Mantle early, and stay relevant through charm picks.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Brand's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, deny his farm: Brand has no dash, so charm him under tower and Spirit Rush out before Pyroclasm's 100s cooldown even matters.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared slow push that crashes on your roam timer — your R makes you the safest roaming mage in the pool. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with R down pre-6 — Ahri without dashes is just a mage with a heal and a reputation. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: crash before he does — Pillar of Flame plus Conflagration clears faster than your orb, so shove first or he roams first. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with R down pre-6 — his W zones you off the last two casters. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.

edits.before: Brand spends Sear (Stun) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Pyroclasm is 100s at rank 1 — bank the third dash to exit once it and Sear are spent.

edits.before: That is Brand’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Ablaze plus Sear is a stun you cannot dodge — trade only unlit.

edits.before: Brand's Pillar of Flame threat and Conflagration passive punish you for pushing in, but you have Fox-Fire flat-out beats his poke trades if you engage.
edits.after: Brand's Pillar of Flame lands after a short delay and Blaze — not Conflagration — is the passive that stacks; step out of the circle and his Sear cannot stun.

edits.before: Use Spirit Rush to close the gap before he can stack Conflagration
edits.after: Use Spirit Rush to close in before Blaze hits three stacks and detonates

notes: Derived-flag misfire recorded: Brand's W carries a 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag, but Riot's own W text describes only a delayed damage zone. The brief's single missingInteraction ('Brand can deny your mobility (Spirit Rush) with Pillar of Flame') is built on that flag alone, so it was NOT written — trusting the description per the calibration rule. If the user can confirm Pillar of Flame has no terrain component, that missing-interaction entry should be deleted at source; it will otherwise keep resurfacing for every Brand matchup in the lane. Level chart: the full layer disagreed with the content layer and the packet on rows 5-7; the three phases[].side flips are proposed as one atomic group and no matching win[] edits exist because win[4..6] already read 'Ahri'. Packet suspectName flagged 'Use Spirit Rush' as a probable wrong ability name — false positive, Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R; the actual error in that string was 'stack Conflagration' (Blaze is what stacks), which is fixed.
